info.title: Atlan REST API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for Atlan's REST APIs.

## Documentation Views
- **Use Cases**: Step-by-step guides organized by task (recommended)
- **Endpoints**: Raw endpoint reference for advanced users

## Authentication
All endpoints require Bearer token authentication via an Atlan API token.
Generate tokens in **Atlan Settings → API Tokens**.

## Base URL
Replace `{tenant}` with your Atlan tenant subdomain (e.g., `acme`, `field-sandbox`).

## Resources
- [Developer Docs](https://developer.atlan.com)
- [SDK Documentation](https://developer.atlan.com/sdks/)

post.description:
Create or update one or more entities in a single request.

This is the primary endpoint for most asset operations. For step-by-step
guides, see the Use Cases documentation.

**Key points:**
- Entities are matched by `qualifiedName` - mismatches create new assets
- Include `typeName`, `name`, and `qualifiedName` for all updates
- Use query parameters to control tag/metadata behavior

parameters.name: replaceTags
parameters.description:
If true, replace all existing tags on the asset(s) with the provided tags.
If false (default), tags are appended.

parameters.name: appendTags
parameters.description:
If true (default), append tags to existing tags.
Mutually exclusive with `replaceTags`.

parameters.name: replaceBusinessAttributes
parameters.description: If true, replace all custom metadata on the asset(s).

parameters.name: overwriteBusinessAttributes
parameters.description: If true, overwrite individual custom metadata attributes (merge behavior).

post.description:
Search Atlan's metadata catalog using an Elasticsearch-style DSL.

This is the primary search endpoint used throughout Atlan for finding assets,
filtering by type, status, ownership, tags, and more.

See [Searching reference](https://developer.atlan.com/search/) for query patterns.

## Use cases
- [Search assets](https://developer.atlan.com/snippets/common-examples/finding/)
- [Search examples](https://developer.atlan.com/snippets/common-examples/finding/examples/)

schema.description:
Request body for metadata search using Elasticsearch-style DSL.

See [Searching reference](https://developer.atlan.com/search/) for query patterns.

dsl.description:
Elasticsearch-like query object. Contains:
- `from` – pagination offset (default 0)
- `size` – page size (default 20, max 10000)
- `track_total_hits` – whether to return accurate total count
- `query` – Elasticsearch query (bool, term, match, etc.)
- `sort` – sort order
- `aggregations` – facets/aggregations

attributes.description:
List of attribute names to include in each entity in the response.
If omitted, only minimal attributes are returned.

schema.description: Response from metadata search.

approximateCount.description: Total matching assets (approximate if track_total_hits is false).
